title: Control Function Available Caller
source_docs: AUTOSAR Blockset/Classic Platform/Basic Software/Function Inhibition Manager (FiM)/Control_Function_Available_Caller.md
text: Call AUTOSAR Function Inhibition Manager (FiM) service interface ControlFunctionAvailable; {Client port name} sets the name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call FiM service interface, {Operation} sets the operation defined in FiM service interface ControlFunctionAvailable and {Sample time} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Client port name
params.values: Name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call FiM service interface ControlFunctionAvailable ControlFunctionAvailable (default) | character vector

params.name: Operation
params.values: Specify operation defined in FiM service interface ControlFunctionAvailable SetFunctionAvailable (default)
